about.name: Coach Joe Davis
about.title: HC/DC/DBs
about.bio:
Coach Joe Davis is a proven 46115 specialist with 9 years of coaching experience at Union County. Known for a disciplined, film-first approach, Coach Davis develops intelligent, technically sound players who make an impact on every down.

If you're looking to elevate your game on the defensive side of the ball and compete at the next level, Coach Davis's coaching is where that journey starts.

hero.headline: Union County's Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized defensive football coaching that turns potential into performance.

services.title: 46115 Defense Installation
services.description: Full 46115 system installation — formations, assignments, stunts, and blitz packages tailored to your personnel.

services.title: Film & Opponent Scouting
services.description: Tendency charting, defensive game-planning, and film breakdown sessions that give your defense the edge before kickoff.

services.title: Linebacker & Secondary Development
services.description: Position-specific coaching for front-seven and DB players — gap control, coverage technique, communication, and tackling.
